english.note: Use this instead of 回顧性 when “looking backwards” is literal, such as a person or animal looking behind itself.

examples.english: The dog by the door gives a retrospective glance as it walks.
examples.traditional: 門口嗰隻向後望嘅狗一路行，一路望返轉頭。
